scope: Contemporary ten-case source-reference development comparison; no clinical performance, therapeutic accuracy or unmodified competitor reproduction

candidate_world.policy: All eligible original admitted observations for each frozen case; per-category whole-record bounded retrieval before dispatch
candidate_world.selection_limitation: The complete collected selected-source case world is offered to bounded retrieval, not all biological knowledge. The 50 Q1 reference rows are sparse evaluator coverage; unreviewed selected claims remain unknown. No claim of a novel held-out biological benchmark.
candidate_world.ancestry: Original admitted agent-evidence observations and raw/reference ancestors only. Evaluator packets, reference answers and external biology are never predictor parents. No newer fallback.

paired_policy.differences: Adapted upstream role workflow uses multiple physical calls; actual call/token/time usage differs and is measured. Simple baselines have no model calls. Same ceilings do not imply identical consumed resources or full-budget success.
paired_policy.output_budget: At most three observation IDs per category after the final accepted stage; no uncapped extractive arm treated as matched
paired_policy.ablations: Remove literature or perturbation before request construction/retrieval and perform fresh eligible model calls. No reuse of full-arm responses and no post-selection-mask claim.
paired_policy.provider_score: Only within a single identified datasource with all finite numeric provider scores; otherwise explicit inapplicable/abstain. Scores remain descriptive, not causal support or features.
paired_policy.order: Freeze a deterministic case/arm execution order before dispatch; temperature zero and fixed seed are not a claim of bitwise inference reproducibility

local_backend.all_contributing_roles: Identical pinned local weights and native runtime, including chief, coordinator, specialist and reviewer
local_backend.network: Model-facing HTTP only to owned IPv4 loopback native server; no model tools, SDK, remote provider, browsing, shell or filesystem capability
local_backend.containment_limit: Trusted Python launcher reads approved paths and owns the server; this is not an OS sandbox for arbitrary agents or a locked historical benchmark

failure_policy: Durable attempts and conservative accounting; no automatic repeat of a failed/timed-out/interrupted call. A stopped role chain cannot commit unreviewed intermediate choices. Partial coverage is reported and not silently excluded from comparison.
prediction_seal: Seal all arm outputs, source manifests, code/configuration, attempts and accounting before any evaluator answer join

evaluation.Q1: Resource annotation fidelity and source-reference coverage only; source support does not establish intervention benefit
evaluation.Q2_Q4: Later external biology is separate evaluator context and is not a mandatory answer in the frozen source world
evaluation.unreviewed: Unknown, never automatically wrong or scientifically validated
evaluation.inference: Descriptive development comparison only; ten purposively chosen cases are not ten proven independent samples. No inferential P values, fake confidence intervals, clinical AUROC/Brier or null-probability imputation.

operational_amendment.reason: Synthesis proposed an ID removed by review; old posthoc guard correctly failed and stopped. Native output schema now enforces the intended subset contract.
